required.description: Recalls separate trace-fraction and clipping-evaluation differences. Does not reduce the old finding to one generic rounding problem.
States that the reference applied the outward correction in the recorded tick-61 mismatch while Wasurf rounded its residual to zero.
Explains that specific evaluation orders reproduced recorded results. Backoff and residual did not use one universal replacement.
Requests a repeatable real-map recording and compares incoming state, trace results, and clipping decisions at the first divergence before changing code.
Distinguishes the successful historical Kitsune replay from the unknown cause of this new mismatch and from full-map/browser verification.

prohibited.description: Recommends removing the outward correction as the established fix.
Claims switching everything to double precision or one generic fused dot product is the previously verified remedy.
Claims the new failure has the same cause or that the historical replay proved complete movement correctness.

pass_rule: All required criteria must pass and no prohibited behavior may occur. Report each criterion separately.
execution_rule: Grade advice and supported historical claims. Do not award credit for claimed live execution.
